summary:
auto-routed: PR ANG-Ventures/hermes-home#3927, PR ANG-Ventures/hermes-home#3843 still open
PR ANG-Ventures/hermes-home#3927 is ready for review but is NOT green, and it needs an operator decision to land. New head 40d87aaed7 is the same diff re-ported onto origin/main as 1 commit; the wip commit was already on main. CI on that head was still running when I handed back. On the prior head 696ab0e2a9 the ci job and 12 other checks were green, but lints-fast was cancelled by the 30-min job cap ("exceeded the maximum execution time of 30m0s"): 124 steps success, 0 failed, 1 cancelled, 289 skipped. Because this PR edits ci.yml and classify.py, every lints-fast suite runs, same shape as #3843. So landing needs one of: raise the lints-fast timeout-minutes, or fleet-merge --allow-red-ci with this evidence. The cap is outside this card's scope, so I did not change it.

What changed:
(1) ci.yml: push:main now uses one concurrency group CI-main with cancel-in-progress false, so at most 1 run is in progress and 1 pending. backstop_base re-tests the files of any replaced pending run.
(2) classify.py --prose-skip, set only on push:main: a diff made only of .md files under plans/, memories/, profiles/*/memories/, skills-shared/ or vault/ runs no suite, prints a ::notice "lints-fast SKIPPED: prose-only push", and skips pip.
(3) rebase_slot: no update-branch while the asking PR's own CI is running on its head. Its want is kept, and it gets 1 update after the run concludes. Unreadable CI state counts as running.
(4) pr-red-triage: new verdict INHERITED-UNKNOWN (exit 2, names the label) when main ran the job on the PR's label within 6 h but never graded it. A job cancelled after every step ended success/skipped counts as graded. A job with a cancelled step never does. RUNNER-CLASS is unchanged.

Local tests on the re-ported head, python3.11:
- fail_open 21/21
- rebase_slot 17 OK
- pr_red_triage 43 OK
- trusted_gate_ref rc 0
- lint-push-concurrency 0 findings

Earlier run on the same diff: lints_fast rc 0, apollo_land_queue 29 OK, horizon_watch 80 OK, land_autopilot 34 OK. review_merge_pass shows the same 24 local env failures with and without this diff.

live-evidence: yes: after the merge, main CI in-flight <= 2 at every 5-min sample. deviations: none.
